description: This file defines the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy class, which extends the PurgeStrategy class. It provides methods to purge records associated with an employee by replacing specified fields with formatted values, utilizing different formatting strategies.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class used for purging entities by replacing certain fields with formatted values.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Fetches and deletes entities associated with an employee number after processing each record for field replacement.

methods.name: purgeRecord
methods.description: Replaces specified fields in the entity with formatted values and persists the changes.

methods.name: getReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new formatter object based on the provided strategy name.
